regime_context: Hong Kong's theme detector shows a narrowing rotation (6 of 17 themes eligible, frac 0.35) with the absolute-trend gate still cutting drawdowns (gate_helps=true), so there IS a supported risk-discipline backdrop — but every theme with a scorable proxy ETF sits at rank 12 or lower and is currently ineligible, meaning all falsifiable leans must be stated as conditionals against the Hang Seng benchmark rather than as active overweight calls. Momentum rank is explicitly only a focus lens, and no crowding flag is triggered anywhere, so this is a low-conviction, watch-and-conditional desk note.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners (currently rank 1, score 2.15, but eligible=false) regains trend-gate eligibility while Conglomerates & Exchange (eligible challenger, margin behind 1.33) holds above a durability_bar of 0.78 — a confirmed handoff from an ineligible leader to an eligible challenger with sustained breadth (both at 1.0) would be the one rotation signal worth updating the overweight lean on Conglomerates & Exchange. If Diversified Miners stays ineligible for 20 more trading days, retire this watch.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: This is the only eligible, rank-2-adjacent theme that is both the headline (weight 0.25) and still trend-gated alive (eligible=true) with the highest durability_bar among eligible financials (0.78). It is the challenger to Diversified Miners, which is ineligible, so Conglomerates & Exchange is the highest-rated theme actually permitted by the absolute-trend gate. The lean is a conditional preference for leadership concentration, not a return forecast.
evidence: eligibility gate passes (eligible=true) while rank-1 Diversified Miners fails (eligible=false)
durability_bar 0.78 is the second-highest of any eligible theme
breadth 1.0 with crowded=false, so no sizing caution is triggered
rotation ledger names it challenger with margin 1.33 behind an ineligible leader
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mixed' rather than 'trend', so the staying-power leg is weaker than true trend names like High-Dividend Blue Chips or Energy; and rotation timing has no validated forward edge, so a confirmed handoff has not occurred.

falsifier.text: Conglomerates & Exchange lags the Hang Seng by 5% or more before the check-by date.
